notes.title: v0.14.0 patch notes
notes.notes:
This update introduces new stores where characters can wear outfits.

[list]
[*] Introduced new stores: Bikini, Casual, and Fashion Wear.
[*] Added 40 new outfit images for characters to purchase.
[*] Implemented a money system for buying character outfits.
[*] Added a notification system for info, success and error feedback.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.13.0 patch notes
notes.notes:
The update features Episode #5, introduces Annie and enhances gameplay.

[list]
[*] Released Episode #5.
[*] Introduced a new character, Annie (futa).
[*] Implemented the mouse girl poke feature (switch between dialogue and hovering girl).
[*] Disabled the context menu across all interfaces.
[*] Enhanced character dialogue names and context.
[*] Added animations to the episode splash intro.
[*] Refactored core class code for easier development.
[*] Enabled backspace functionality for backward navigation.
[*] Improved various QOL game features for a better user experience.
[*] New description of Rosie's lingerie in drunk scene.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.12.0 patch notes
notes.notes:
New release which primarily focuses on bug fixes and enhanced UI sound effects.

[list]
[*] Fix model animation issues that cause it to disappear when skipping dialogues and scenes.
[*] Reset initial model when retrying a sliding puzzle.
[*] Ensure current audio is properly destroyed when quitting an episode.
[*] Suppress input events during element transitions to prevent hidden audio effects from triggering.
[*] Refactor and enhance UI sound effects, including clicks, hovers, and transitions.
[*] Resolve the exit game bug on Windows platforms.
[/list]
